name: push_with_handle
declaration: unsafe fn push_with_handle < 'b > (& mut self , key : K , val : V ,) -> Handle < NodeRef < marker :: Mut < 'b > , K , V , marker :: Leaf > , marker :: KV >
parent: NodeRef < marker :: Mut < 'a > , K , V , marker :: Leaf >
documentation:
Adds a key-value pair to the end of the node, and returns
 a handle to the inserted value.

 # Safety

 The returned handle has an unbound lifetime.
rules: The caller must constrain the returned handle's unbound lifetime `'b` so that the handle does not outlive the node it references.
